detailed_descriptions.en: The Headlands is a cozy farming strategy about a small Ukrainian village caught between two eras: Soviet machinery and an independent countryside on the verge of the 2000s. Ahead of you lies a run-down farm waiting for a new beginning. Start small: an old tractor, a neglected field and limited resources. Step by step, work the land, sow the grain, bring in the harvest and gradually build a farm that runs on your decisions. At the heart of the game are your own pace and balance. You decide which fields to work first, when to invest in new machinery and how to make the most of your time, fuel and grain. Market prices live a life of their own — and sometimes the price of grain shifts exactly when it is already in the truck bed. There are no timers pushing you and no sudden punishments — only thoughtful planning and steady, tangible progress. Every tractor here is the one you saw in the fields as a child: the same engine, the same rattle, the same peeling paint. Maybe you even remember the moustachioed neighbour who once let you climb into the cab while he checked something under the hood — and you sat there alone like a cosmonaut in a spacecraft, studying every lever and every button. Every machine in the game has its own character and story. And you won't be left alone with them: there is always a mechanic and mentor nearby who will advise you, and in his spare time will put together a machine that has no name in any catalogue. Help your neighbours through contracts, unlock new opportunities and turn a small holding into a living, well-run farm. Start small. Give the land time. And you'll see everything begin to grow. 🌾 Meditative strategy gameplay. Planning without rush and the freedom to choose your own pace. 🚜 Gradual farm growth. From a single tractor to a full holding with a large fleet and expanded buildings. 📦 A living market and resource balance. Time, fuel and harvest are all connected, and prices won't wait until you are ready. 🔧 Machines with character. Dozens of vehicles with a history — from the mechanic's homemade "masterpieces" to heavy combines. 🏭 Your own production — set up supply chains and sell finished goods for more than raw materials. 🤝 Contracts and village life. Help your neighbours and develop the region together.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The Headlands is a cozy farming strategy about a small Ukrainian village caught between two eras: Soviet machinery and an independent countryside on the verge of the 2000s. Ahead of you lies a run-down farm waiting for a new beginning.

Start small: an old tractor, a neglected field and limited resources. Step by step, work the land, sow the grain, bring in the harvest and gradually build a farm that runs on your decisions.

At the heart of the game are your own pace and balance. You decide which fields to work first, when to invest in new machinery and how to make the most of your time, fuel and grain. Market prices live a life of their own — and sometimes the price of grain shifts exactly when it is already in the truck bed. There are no timers pushing you and no sudden punishments — only thoughtful planning and steady, tangible progress.

Every tractor here is the one you saw in the fields as a child: the same engine, the same rattle, the same peeling paint. Maybe you even remember the moustachioed neighbour who once let you climb into the cab while he checked something under the hood — and you sat there alone like a cosmonaut in a spacecraft, studying every lever and every button.

Every machine in the game has its own character and story. And you won't be left alone with them: there is always a mechanic and mentor nearby who will advise you, and in his spare time will put together a machine that has no name in any catalogue.

Help your neighbours through contracts, unlock new opportunities and turn a small holding into a living, well-run farm.

Start small. Give the land time. And you'll see everything begin to grow.

🌾 Meditative strategy gameplay. Planning without rush and the freedom to choose your own pace.

🚜 Gradual farm growth. From a single tractor to a full holding with a large fleet and expanded buildings.

📦 A living market and resource balance. Time, fuel and harvest are all connected, and prices won't wait until you are ready.

🔧 Machines with character. Dozens of vehicles with a history — from the mechanic's homemade "masterpieces" to heavy combines.

🏭 Your own production — set up supply chains and sell finished goods for more than raw materials.

🤝 Contracts and village life. Help your neighbours and develop the region together.
